req.title: Reject wrong method on /patch
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 for methods other than PATCH on /patch.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the /patch endpoint should only accept PATCH requests and return a 405 Method Not Allowed for any other HTTP methods. This ensures that the endpoint is accessed correctly and prevents misuse. The test suite will include a positive test for a valid PATCH request, a negative test for an invalid method, and a boundary test to ensure the 405 response is consistent across different invalid methods.

tests.name: test_patch_method_allowed
actions: Send a PATCH request to the /patch endpoint.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.patch('/patch')
assert response.status_code == 200

tests.name: test_get_method_not_allowed_on_patch
actions: Send a GET request to the /patch endpoint.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/patch')
assert response.status_code == 405

tests.name: test_post_method_not_allowed_on_patch
actions: Send a POST request to the /patch endpoint.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.post('/patch')
assert response.status_code == 405
